scope: Reconcile image-source photography identity, dimensions, and reuse evidence for two already approved Class I paintings. No image bytes acquired; no ratings, canonical IDs, selections, or production records changed.

painting.title: Christ in the Wilderness (Christ in the Desert)

records.subjectRelation: Related to Matthew 4:1–11: Christ's solitude and inner struggle; the image does not show Satan or a literal confrontation.

reproduction.sourceDescription: Google Cultural Institute reproduction hosted on Wikimedia Commons
reproduction.accessionCrosswalk: Commons file metadata identifies Tretyakov accession 651 and the 1872 oil-on-canvas painting.
reproduction.photographicIdentity: Source metadata names Google Cultural Institute reproduction; exact pixel comparison to Tretyakov's current object image was unavailable.

rights.evidence: File-specific Public Domain Mark / PD-Art record states this is a faithful reproduction of a two-dimensional public-domain painting and no known copyright or neighbouring right is asserted.
rights.reuseStatus: Provisional by jurisdiction; Commons itself cautions that reuse may differ outside the United States. The artist died in 1887; underlying painting is public domain in life-plus-100 jurisdictions, but that does not independently clear this photographic reproduction worldwide.

records.mobileQA: Source ratio 1.141 versus painted dimensions 180 × 210 cm (ratio 0.857, noting Tretyakov/record orientation may need confirmation); no pixel inspection or crop certification. Avoid tight portrait crop until photo-to-object comparison.

records.scope: Existing approved Class I — 1 March; same painting also used as a source route for 6 August Transfiguration
records.subjectRelation: Exact Transfiguration in the upper register; the same full panel includes the healing of the possessed boy in the lower register.

reproduction.photoIdentity: Commons file identifies Vatican Pinacoteca inv. 4; its attribution and image ratio closely match the official painting record. No pixel comparison was possible.
reproduction.dimensionNote: The file title gives 405 × 278 cm; structured metadata reports 410 × 279 cm. This small catalogue discrepancy does not alter the accession match.

rights.photoLicence: Explicit Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0) for the photograph, with attribution, licence link, and indication of modifications required.
rights.paintingRights: Underlying Renaissance painting is public domain. The explicit CC BY 4.0 evidence applies to the photographer's reproduction and is the controlling image-use route for this file.
rights.reuseStatus: Image-level reuse route found; retain attribution and licence. Vatican's own image terms are not being treated as a licence for this Commons photograph.

records.mobileQA: Image ratio 0.677; painted dimensions 278/405 = 0.686, close (about 1.3% difference). Preserve the full vertical panel because the lower register is integral; no pixel crop QA or production certification.
